parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data source to which the certificate belongs.

Required: You must specify at least one of this parameter and CaIdentifier. If neither is specified, the API returns MissingParameter.Id/CaIdentifier (400)
parameters.help_zh:
证书所属数据源id。

必填说明：与CaIdentifier二者至少提供其一、缺失时 API 返回 MissingParameter.Id/CaIdentifier(400)
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The total number of certificate records.

If this parameter is not specified, the API returns MissingParameter.CertTotalCount (400)
parameters.help_zh:
证书记录总数。

未提供时 API 返回 MissingParameter.CertTotalCount(400)
parameters.name: cert_total_count

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the CA certificate.
Only end-entity (SUB_ROOT) CA instances are accepted.
Call the ListPcaCaCertificate operation to obtain a list of valid CAs that contain IssuerIdentifier.

Required: You must specify at least one of this parameter and Id. If neither is specified, the API returns MissingParameter.Id/CaIdentifier (400)
parameters.help_zh:
CA证书标识。
仅接受 end-entity（SUB_ROOT）CA 实例，
通过 ListPcaCaCertificate 获取含 IssuerIdentifier 的有效 CA 列表。

必填说明：与ID二者至少提供其一、缺失时 API 返回 MissingParameter.Id/CaIdentifier(400)
parameters.name: ca_identifier

CurrentYearFreeCertCount.description_en: The number of free certificates for the current year. [Deprecated]
